articles.headline: Premier League recap: Newcastle draw Arsenal, Leeds upset Chelsea
articles.description: Club soccer returned across Europe this weekend following the final international break of 2026. Check out all the highlights from Saturday's action.
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグまとめ：ニューカッスルがアーセナルと引き分け、リーズがチェルシーに金星
articles.descriptionJa: 2026年の最後のインターナショナルブレイクを終え、今週末から欧州各地でクラブサッカーが再開しました。土曜日の試合のハイライトをチェックしましょう。
articles.body:
The final international break of 2026 is over, and club soccer is back across Europe!

We kicked off in the Premier League, where Enzo Maresca's Manchester City were forced to come from behind and rescue a 1-1 draw at home to Fulham.

Then a full slate of matches happened simultaneously as Chelsea were stunned in a 4-1 loss at home to Leeds United while Tottenham Hotspur cruised past Ipswich Town 2-0. Finally, in our match of the day, Newcastle United hosted league leaders and defending champions Arsenal and battled to a 2-2 draw.

There was plenty of action elsewhere across Europe, too. In the Bundesliga, Borussia Mönchengladbach fell 1-0 Borussia Dortmund, while Serie A leaders Lazio won 3-0 over Lecce and Ligue 1 leaders Paris Saint-Germain emerged with a 3-2 victory over Nice.

Take a look back at all the highlights from Saturday's matches across the continent.

articles.headline: Désiré Doué stretchered off with knee injury as PSG beat Nice 3-2
articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain forward Désiré Doué was carried off on a stretcher late in the first half of the team's Ligue 1 match away to Nice on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: PSGがニースに3-2で勝利、デジレ・ドゥエが膝の負傷で担架で運び出される
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜日のリーグ・アン、ニースでのアウェイ戦において、パリ・サンジェルマンのフォワード、デジレ・ドゥエが前半終了間際に膝の負傷により担架で運び出されました。
articles.body:
Paris Saint-Germain forward Désiré Doué was carried off on a stretcher late in the first half of the team's Ligue 1 match away to Nice on Saturday.

The injury happened when he turned to shield the ball from Nice midfielder Sofiane Diop and his leg buckled under him without any contact from Diop.

The France forward fell to the ground clutching his right knee in the 39th minute and looked in severe pain as he cried out. Moments later he was taken off on a stretcher and placed both hands on his face.

21 year old Doué -- who shot to prominence with an outstanding performance in the 2025 Champions League win against Inter Milan -- had scored his second league goal of the season earlier in the first half.

Spain forward Ferran Torres replaced him.

Two-time defending champions PSG face Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday.

Doué's injury is a concern for coach Luis Enrique, after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia tore the ACL in his right knee against Barcelona on Oct. 20 and Ousmane Dembélé and captain Marquinhos tore thigh muscles in that game.

Dembélé came off the bench against Nice in the second half.

articles.headline: Tottenham's De Zerbi likens Williams-Barnett to Yamal after star stunning full debut
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi was not surprised by a dazzling full debut display from "special" talent Luca Williams-Barnett and compared the 18-year-old to Barcelona's Lamine Yamal.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナムのデ・ゼルビ、鮮烈なフルデビューを飾ったウィリアムズ＝バーネットをヤマルになぞらえる
articles.descriptionJa: トッテナム・ホットスパーのロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督は、「特別な」才能を持つルカ・ウィリアムズ＝バーネットが見せた輝かしいフルデビューのパフォーマンスに驚くことはなく、この18歳をバルセロナのラミン・ヤマルと比較しました。
articles.body:
Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi was not surprised by a dazzling full debut display from "special" talent Luca Williams-Barnett and compared the 18-year-old to Barcelona's Lamine Yamal after Saturday's 2-0 win over Ipswich.

De Zerbi turned to the highly-rated Spurs academy graduate after two bright cameos and he delivered with aplomb, scoring on his first Premier League start after 15 minutes before a mazy run set up Dominic Solanke at the start of the second half.

After Williams-Barnett made his senior debut at the age of 16 last season, the clamour for the teenager to play has only increased during a difficult last 12 months and De Zerbi decided 10 days ago to include him in the starting XI against Ipswich.

During a chat on Thursday with the skilful England Under-19 international, De Zerbi asked Williams-Barnett to play with freedom and work hard without the ball "like Raphinha, like Yamal" before he agreed when asked if the teenager could reach similar heights.

After De Zerbi revealed Williams-Barnett prepared for the match on the team bus by watching YouTube clips of Ronaldinho, Eden Hazard and Neymar, he said: "Luca is a special player.

"I'm not surprised, because his talent is bigger than you think. He played very well. I think he's lucky, because he's playing in a top club, with top teammates.

"I decided to play today with Luca from 10 days and in my plan, it was [James] Maddison and Luca very close to speak the same language, to play together and the experience of Maddison I thought could be important.

"The behaviour of Maddison could help him to play with freedom. And Thursday, I spoke with Luca and I asked him two things. Just two things. To play like he plays on the park with his friends, with the same freedom.

"And to play and to work hard without the ball, like [Ousmane] Dembélé, like Raphinha, like Yamal, because football is going in a different way and the first defenders are the attackers.

"Even if they are Ballon d'Or winners, or any way the players with talent, they have to work on the pitch."

Asked if Williams-Barnett can reach the level of Yamal, De Zerbi said: "Yes, I think so.

"And one of the best things in my career... I've seen today in the bus from the training ground to the stadium, because he was very close with me, while we were coming in the stadium, he was watching on YouTube Ronaldinho, Hazard, Neymar.

"I thought he was a special guy, because if one hour and thirty minutes before you are debuting in the Premier League, you are watching Ronaldinho, Hazard, Neymar, all these types of talent. The football is magic, no?"

Gary O'Neil watched Ipswich's winless run extend to five matches.

"Many of us weren't quite able to get to the level that we're used to. A tough afternoon. I didn't enjoy it but I did enjoy watching the lads dig in and find a way to keep going together in a tough moment because that's what we need," O'Neil said.

articles.headline: Enzo Maresca: Man City denied 'clear' goal in draw with Fulham
articles.description: Enzo Maresca said Manchester City were denied a "clear" goal in their 1-1 draw with Fulham after Erling Haaland was judged to have fouled goalkeeper Bernd Leno.
articles.headlineJa: エンツォ・マレスカ：フルハムとの引き分け試合でマンチェスター・シティの「明らかな」ゴールが認められず
articles.descriptionJa: エンツォ・マレスカは、フルハムとの1-1の引き分け試合において、アーリング・ハーランドがゴールキーパーのベルント・レノにファウルをしたと判定されたため、マンチェスター・シティの「明らかな」ゴールが取り消されたと述べた。
articles.body:
Enzo Maresca said Manchester City were denied a "clear" goal in their 1-1 draw with Fulham after Erling Haaland was judged to have fouled goalkeeper Bernd Leno.

Haaland thought he had scored when he bundled the ball over the line from Iliman Ndiaye's cross. But referee Tom Bramall decided Leno had control of the ball, a view backed up by VAR.

"I review the goal after the game and from my point of view it is quite clear that it is not a foul, but I am not the guy who decides," Maresca said.

The City boss also said Haaland was convinced he had scored when the ball appeared to slip out of Leno's grasp.

"He was absolutely sure even when they were reviewing the VAR that it was a goal because I asked from the touchline, but the referee decided differently," Maresca said.

City have now gone four Premier League games without a win and nine games in all competitions without a clean sheet.

Fulham, meanwhile, snapped a 20-match losing run against City stretching back to 2011.

- Man City, Enzo Maresca at a crossroads after Premier League stumble

- Fulham finally end 15-year losing run against Man City

- Man City draw 1-1 with Fulham, City's winless streak extends to four matches

"Obviously we knew we lost the last 20 times we played Manchester City, but I told them we would have the chance to beat them if we play with courage, with character," Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa said.

"I won the last time I was here [with Real Madrid], so I thought maybe we would have the chance to win. I think we performed really well. We could win the game."

articles.headline: Titans DL Jaylen Harrell hospitalized after car accident in Tampa
articles.description: Titans defensive lineman Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident Friday and remains hospitalized, according to the team.
articles.headlineJa: タイタンズのDLジェイレン・ハレル、タンパでの自動車事故で入院
articles.descriptionJa: チームの発表によると、タイタンズのディフェンシブラインマン、ジェイレン・ハレルが金曜日に深刻な自動車事故に遭い、現在も入院している。
articles.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- Tennessee Titans defensive lineman Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident Friday and remains hospitalized, according to the team.

Harrell, 24, was a passenger in an Uber in Tampa, Florida, when the accident occurred. No further details were available.

"Yesterday, Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident that resulted in him being taken to the hospital in his hometown of Tampa, Florida," the Titans said in a statement. "We have been in constant communication with Jaylen's family and are still working to gather more information.

"At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care. We ask that Jaylen and his family's privacy be respected at this time. We will provide an update when appropriate."

Harrell tore his ACL in the preseason and was placed on season-ending injured reserve. The Titans selected Harrell in the seventh round of the 2024 draft, and he finished his rookie season with 13 combined tackles.

He started two games for Tennessee in 2025 and 25 combined tackles, including 4.5 sacks and a forced fumble.

articles.headline: 76ers' Jaylen Brown, Dean Wade out, Tyrese Maxey starting vs. Bucks
articles.description: 76ers forwards Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade will miss Saturday's game against the Bucks with left hamstring injuries, their second straight game out.
articles.headlineJa: 76ersのジェイレン・ブラウンとディーン・ウェイドが欠場、バックス戦はタイリース・マクシーが先発
articles.descriptionJa: 76ersのフォワード、ジェイレン・ブラウンとディーン・ウェイドは左ハムストリングの負傷により、土曜日のバックス戦を欠場する。これで2試合連続の欠場となる。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- 76ers forwards Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade will miss Saturday's game against the Bucks with left hamstring injuries, their second straight game out.

Guard Tyrese Maxey, who also missed the Sixers' win Wednesday over the Orlando Magic with foot soreness, was listed as questionable but will start.

Big man Dominick Barlow (back), who hasn't played yet this season, is probable. Center Adem Bona (neck) is out.

The Sixers said Brown went through individual work at Friday's practice and that Maxey, Wade and Bona were "unrestricted" during the session. Bona, who last played Nov. 4, still needs to go through "contact" play to be fully cleared, the team said.

The Sixers will play the Portland Trail Blazers next on Monday in Philadelphia.

articles.headline: Bournemouth win again, beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 to climb to fourth in Premier League table
articles.description: Bournemouth extended their winning run to nine in all competitions as Evanilson scored for the sixth Premier League game in a row in a 2-0 win over Nottingham Forest.
articles.headlineJa: ボーンマスが快勝、ノッティンガム・フォレストに2-0で勝利しプレミアリーグ4位に浮上
articles.descriptionJa: ボーンマスはノッティンガム・フォレストに2-0で勝利し、全大会合わせて9連勝を飾った。エバニルソンはプレミアリーグ6試合連続ゴールを記録した。
articles.body:
Bournemouth extended their winning run to nine in all competitions as Evanilson scored for the sixth Premier League game in a row in a 2-0 win over Nottingham Forest.

Justin Kluivert was also on target to help Marco Rose's Cherries climb up to the dizzying heights of fourth place in the table.

The defeat means Forest are only above the relegation places on goal difference having failed to build on the momentum of their 3-1 win over Manchester City before the international break.

Both teams started the game on the front foot and Forest had the first sight of goal. Neco Williams nodded dangerously across the face of goal at the far post, but Liam Delap was beaten to the ball by home defender António Silva.

Evanilson was denied by a brilliant last-ditch tackle from Forest centre-back Jair Cunha before Marcus Tavernier's 20-yard curler was well saved by Matz Sels.

Bournemouth took the lead through Evanilson in the 19th minute. James Hill cushioned a header into the path of Evanilson, and the in-form Brazilian took one touch before blasting a left-footed shot into the roof of the net.

Kluivert almost doubled the home side's lead with an effort from the edge of the penalty area which sailed narrowly over the crossbar.

Evanilson then failed to keep his shot down after a long throw from Hill caused chaos in the Forest penalty area.

Oliver Glasner's side had a penalty appeal waved away when Adam Smith blocked Williams's effort into the arm of teammate Tyler Adams.

Kluivert did make it 2-0 on the stroke of half-time with a simple far-post finish after a superb run and cross from Tavernier.

Forest were much improved in the second half, adopting a more direct approach in a bid to forage a way back into the game.

Delap turned provider by whipping in a cross for captain Morgan Gibbs-White but the England international could not properly connect with his header.

James McAtee ballooned an effort over the crossbar as the visitors continued to misfire in front of goal.

Substitute Chris Wood also miscued a header from a corner when he should have at least tested underworked Bournemouth goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic.

Bournemouth always looked a threat on the counter and Kluivert came close to his second and the Cherries' third when he stung the gloves of Selz from 18 yards out.

Kluivert should also have been more clinical when he found himself within finishing range but unselfishly laid the ball off to Rayan and the chance went begging.

articles.headline: Lakers rally after JJ Redick rips team's lack of fight vs. last-place Kings
articles.description: Lakers coach JJ Redick ripped into the team's lack of fight after trailing the last-place Kings at halftime, and Los Angeles went on to eke out a 106-104 win.
articles.headlineJa: レイカーズが逆転勝利、JJ・レディック監督が最下位キングス戦での「闘志不足」を激しく批判
articles.descriptionJa: レイカーズのJJ・レディック監督は、ハーフタイムで最下位のキングスにリードされていた際、チームの闘志不足を激しく叱咤。その後、ロサンゼルスは106-104で辛うじて勝利を収めた。
articles.body:
LOS ANGELES -- With his team looking listless and trailing the last-place Kings by eight at halftime Friday, Lakers coach JJ Redick had seen enough.

"I feel I did a decent job of regulating at halftime," Redick said after Los Angeles' eventual 106-104 win. "They may have a differing opinion of that. Can't repeat every word I used. The main message was we've got to be tougher, we've got to bring a little bit of energy."

Lakers center Walker Kessler was one of Redick's targets after totaling six points, one rebound and four fouls at the break, while Kings big man Domantas Sabonis racked up 15 points and eight boards.

"He lit me up a little bit, rightfully so," Kessler said. "But it was constructive. He was like, 'I know you can do this. Do it.'"

Kessler finished with 15 points, seven rebounds and three blocks and was a key contributor as Los Angeles outscored Sacramento 52-42 over the final two quarters.

"I wasn't playing physical. I wasn't going up to dunk the ball. I was missing some more touches around the rim," Kessler said. "And then defensively, being undisciplined, jumping at stuff I don't need to jump at.

"He definitely lit into me. It was good. I needed it. That's what makes a good coach. Knowing when guys need that and when guys don't."

Luka Doncic, who led the Lakers with 25 points on 9-of-18 shooting and eight assists -- and committed only two of his six turnovers after halftime -- also approved of Redick's approach.

"I mean, he yells, but I'm used to it," said Doncic, who was hit in the right eye by the Kings' Keegan Murray late in the fourth quarter but said postgame he would be fine. "Got us all fired up. Sometimes it's good to yell."

The Lakers home crowd would have been screaming in agony had Kings guard Zach LaVine's potential game-winning 3-pointer gone in at the buzzer. But it clanked off the front rim, dropping Sacramento to 1-14 on the season and lifting Los Angeles to 14-3, including 2-1 in NBA Cup games.

As dominant as the Lakers' record looks -- No. 1 in the Western Conference and the most wins in the NBA -- Friday capped a tough week against generally weaker opponents.

On Sunday, the Phoenix Suns cut the Lakers' 18-point fourth-quarter lead to five before Los Angeles could close out the win. On Tuesday, the Lakers needed 47 points from Quentin Grimes to outlast the lowly Charlotte Hornets in overtime. On Wednesday, the Utah Jazz, who came into the game with a 2-13 record, outscored the Lakers by 10 in the fourth quarter to shock them on their home court.

And then there was Friday, when Grimes' 3 with 57 seconds remaining broke a 103-103 tie to put the Lakers ahead and avoid another disastrous loss to one of the West's worst teams.

"I feel like it's good for us," said Grimes, who shot 2-for-7 but scored 13 points thanks to going 8-for-9 from the foul line. "It's a good test early in the season."

articles.headline: Fantasy basketball adds and NBA bets: Zero in on Acuff Jr., Queta on Saturday
articles.description: Jim McCormick breaks down Saturday's NBA slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.
articles.body:
Saturday's six-game slate is split evenly between competitive matchups and potential blowouts. Three of today's games have point spreads of at least 11.5 points, while the other half ranges between 5.5 and 6.5, evidence of closer, competitive climates.

Today's injury report reveals some impact absences, such as Jaylen Brown missing from the Philadelphia 76ers' lineup as he continues to heal from a hamstring ailment. Tyrese Maxey, meanwhile, is questionable due to a foot issue that held him out in Orlando earlier this week.

Keep an eye on Deni Avdija's status for this marquee matchup in MSG against the New York Knicks. The competitive line hints at Avdija being active.

Brandon Ingram is expected to make his debut on Monday against the Houston Rockets. Despite being a proven bucket and playmaker, Ingram remains a free agent in a third of ESPN leagues.

The Memphis Grizzlies won't have star rookie Cameron Boozer tonight against the Minnesota Timberwolves, setting up a pair of frontcourt peers in the streaming section below.

With Dylan Harper out for the San Antonio Spurs, Julian Champagnie stands to benefit most after replacing him in the starting lineup Thursday and scoring 20 points, while De'Aaron Fox should consume additional ballhandling and playmaking responsibilities.

It looks like Jayson Tatum is resting versus the Sacramento Kings tonight, elevating the likes of Baylor Scheierman and Hugo Gonzalez for those in deeper formats.

With an eye on identifying rewarding fantasy decisions and savvy bets, let's look at the day in the NBA

Fantasy stream team

Players available in at least 50% of leagues

Neemias Queta, C, Boston Celtics (rostered in 24.7% of ESPN leagues)

Queta doesn't quit, as his relentless effort on both sides can deliver some inspired box score appearances. With a double-double in two of his past three games, and now the blend of Tatum's minutes and potential rebounds filtering through the frontcourt, along with a matchup with the worst rebounding team in the league in the Kings.

Brook Lopez, C, LA Clippers (38.9%)

With Ingram's season debut coming soon, Lopez remains the team's secondary scoring threat. Lopez has handled this surprising rule with real success, up to 15.4 point per game on the year and often flirting with 20 points on a fun shot diet from deep. Add in his rim protection and you have a dynamic fantasy option at a shallow position.

Cam Spencer, PG, Memphis Grizzlies (37.4%)

One of the leagues' better distributors regarding passing effectiveness and efficiency, Spencer could take on more work with Boozer's high-post touches missing from the lineup. Spencer's ability to thrive alongside Ty Jerome as both an on- and off-ball threat drives real value for him in this matchup with Minnesota.

Taylor Hendricks, PF, Memphis Grizzlies (2.9%)
